# JetNine

> JetNine is a private-aviation charter brokerage: access to roughly 20,000 aircraft worldwide, curated down to a few vetted airframes per trip and arranged by a 24/7 human dispatch desk.

JetNine arranges on-demand private jet charter, discounted empty-leg flights, and membership programs. Trips fly on independently vetted FAA Part 135 operators (ARGUS / Wyvern / IS-BAO standards). Quotes are generated through the on-site wizard with live indicative pricing, and the dispatch desk answers +1 (424) 487-2707 around the clock. JetNine LLC is a 14 CFR Part 295 indirect air carrier based in Los Angeles.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://jetnine.com/): What JetNine is and how the desk works.
- [Fleet & aircraft](https://jetnine.com/aircraft): Categories from turboprop to ultra-long-range, with individual aircraft model pages, cabin specs, and photography.
- [How it works](https://jetnine.com/how-it-works): The quote-to-flight process, step by step.
- [Cost calculator](https://jetnine.com/cost-calculator): Instant charter cost estimates by route and aircraft category.
- [Memberships](https://jetnine.com/memberships): Membership and jet-card programs.
- [Empty legs](https://jetnine.com/empty-legs): Discounted repositioning flights, with SMS/email route alerts.
- [Safety](https://jetnine.com/safety): Operator vetting, pilot standards, and safety ratings explained.
- [Request a quote](https://jetnine.com/quote/mission): Start a charter quote — options within 30 minutes during operating hours.
